context: Agent is asked to generate a full SKILL.md for an invented, non-real comedic tradition with no living performer involved.

checklist.name: Completes analysis before writing
checklist.description: Agent works through (or visibly reflects) the analysis checklist for the requested tradition before producing final instructions, rather than jumping straight to prose.

checklist.name: Concrete mechanics, not adjectives
checklist.description: The generated skill's Core mechanics section contains specific, imperative, tradition-specific rules rather than vague adjectives like 'funny' or 'dark'.

checklist.name: Required structural elements present
checklist.description: Delivered SKILL.md includes name, description with negative anchor and workflow anchor, a title, Core mechanics, and a Structure/Workflow section.

checklist.name: Fidelity sections present
checklist.description: Delivered SKILL.md includes a Mindset statement of the comic engine, a BAD/GOOD failure-mode pair per core mechanic, a Troubleshooting section of symptom-to-fix branches, and labelled worked examples per mechanic.

checklist.name: Original-material instruction included
checklist.description: The generated skill explicitly instructs producing original material rather than reproducing existing text.

checklist.name: No unnecessary living-performer hedging
checklist.description: Agent does not incorrectly apply or discuss the living-performer conversion rule for a style that names no real performer.
